description:
Delete the executor's whole-repository graph-rule evaluation, the validation captures only it used, and the single-rule graph entry points that only the replaced rule view and checker called.

## Background

- `evaluate_graph_rules` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:1557-1600`) evaluates every graph rule over a caller-supplied issue list with rules and namespaces from the executor's disk caches, and `image_plan_content` (`:1614-1623`) captures a whole validation image to read plan documents for it. `capture_validation_image` (`:164-166`, private) serves `image_plan_content` and the former rule view (`:1967`); `capture_validation_image_with` (`:180-200`, `pub(crate)`) serves it and test fixtures (`commands/gate_check.rs` tests at `:2194,3061,3548`; the overlay tests in `crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs` at `:931,949,959`).
- `validation::graph::evaluate_graph_rule` (`crates/jit/src/validation/graph.rs:490-500`) and `graph_rule_plan_source_ids` (`:431-454`) were called only by `rule_validation_outcome`, which served the former rule view and rule checker. Both are public, so the build does not flag them.
- Their remaining caller is `test_rule_scoped_evaluation_isolates_firing_issue_from_repository_context` (`graph.rs:4040`), whose property the Rule clause of the selection property test owns.
- Remaining test callers of `evaluate_graph_rules`: `test_evaluate_graph_rules_preserves_invalid_hierarchy_error` (`commands/validate.rs:2530`) and one call in `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/config_loading_tests.rs:121`.
- f8a6b298's read-driver work (578ed10d) moves `capture_validation_image_with` onto the read session and follows this change, so it moves only what remains.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `evaluate_graph_rules`, `image_plan_content`, `capture_validation_image` and `capture_validation_image_with` no longer exist; their test callers capture through the validation capture the views use.
- [hard] REQ-02: `evaluate_graph_rule`, `graph_rule_plan_source_ids` and the `graph.rs` test that calls them no longer exist; the removed case is owned by the Rule clause of the selection property test.
- [hard] REQ-03: The migrated `evaluate_graph_rules` callers assert the same properties through the report or the findings issue creation returns.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Remove the executor's graph evaluation and the single-rule graph entry points
